description: Second representation: executable depth-two conditional trees on Boolean repair; frozen before this extension's first measured run, not an external preregistration.
notes: All initial syntax is fixed before results. No tuning on extension outcomes.
Both local methods edit the evolving tree incumbent; only active author differs.
Protected selection accepts strict training improvements; all evaluator calls count.
Whole-program uniform random search is retained even if stronger.
Primary finite-sample empirical Bernstein intervals are simultaneous across the three task families.
Other cells are descriptive; approximate standard errors are labeled as such.
B-dependent task policies are restarted separately at each B, not read from a prefix.
C=16 is a checkpoint of a C=64 development schedule, not a separately re-timed run.
No claim of one-percent equivalence is precommitted for this study.
